focus: Corrected a long-standing false entry on the public release page. A cross-project dependency was being reported as outstanding because the tracker watched for a message that had since expired, rather than checking whether the work itself was done -- it had been done for months. The check now verifies the real thing directly against the login provider, including a deliberate negative test to prove the check can still fail, and it expires after two weeks so it cannot vouch for something indefinitely. The remaining sign-in work is unchanged and still pending a person completing it, and that restriction was left in place on purpose.
